answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind identities through cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. A zero-knowledge lantern shines verifiable validity over private credentials across an ocean of nodes. Staking requirements scale superlinearly per identity, turning identity multiplication into exponential capital exhaustion. As malicious actors spawn identities, their cost curve escalates into a sable financial abyss, rendering swarms economically unfeasible.
